world.bio: I manage six matatus on the Thika Road route (Nairobi CBD to Thika), with eight conductors and drivers on rotation. I know every conductor's habits and every traffic cop's mood. Married, two kids in primary school. Goalkeeper in a weekend league. My mother has a small tea farm in Nyeri.
skills_assets: Operating knowledge of the Thika Road matatu route, including stage timing, SACCO rules and the weekly NTSA check-in
Six 33-seater minibuses, three of them paid off
Contacts at two garages in Githurai, a tyre dealer in Ruiru and a mechanic who works nights
Simple M-Pesa float system for daily collections
A notebook with every fine, date and plate number since January

projects.name: County fines audit
projects.text: Nairobi county fines on my matatus have doubled this year. I've been writing every ticket in a notebook with date, plate, officer's name, amount. Suspicion: some of the tickets don't match the county system. When I paid through the e-citizen portal, a few of them showed 'no record'. Called the SACCO chair; he says 'pay and move on'. I don't want to move on.

projects.name: Engine overhaul for KDG 417T
projects.text: One of my older buses has a leaking head gasket. Mechanic in Githurai quotes KES 85,000 for full overhaul. Bus out of route for six days costs me roughly 30,000 in lost takings.

projects.name: Water tank for Mama's farm
projects.text: Her roof tank in Nyeri cracked in the dry season. A 5,000 litre tank plus fittings is around KES 60,000. Need to arrange by December before the short rains.

notes.text: Monday. Samuel (conductor) came back with 4,200 less than expected on KDF 902. Said traffic was bad. I know that route, traffic wasn't that bad. Will watch him this week without saying anything.
Football: kept a clean sheet, 1-0. My knees hurt on the way home. Wife says I am too old to dive on concrete. Probably true.
Another ticket: KES 10,000 for 'obstruction' at Roysambu stage. We were not even in the stage. Photo evidence? None, as always. Officer's name written: Constable Mwangi.

Checked my notebook. In January fines totalled 38,000 across six buses. In August, 94,000. Either my drivers have all become reckless or the rules have changed. Probably both. I want to see if the ticket numbers are real.
School fees: Wanjiru and Brian's term three fees paid, but January bill will be 112,000 for both. Savings stand at 40,000. Matatu income dips in December.
Mama phoned; the tank leaks now. Told her I'd send money by month-end. She said 'don't kill yourself for me'. Hard to hear.
Mechanic Otieno said the head gasket will last maybe two more weeks. I can't afford the downtime before the end-of-month.
Samuel confessed. He's been giving a friend free rides. Warned him once. Not firing him, he has a baby. Docked 1,000.

messages.text: Ndungu: Joseph, just pay the fines. Me: Some of them are not showing in the system. Ndungu: Not my problem. Me: It might be someone else's pocket. Ndungu: Careful what you say.
Esther: School called about fees. Me: Not due till January. Esther: Okay but they want a plan. Me: I'll write one.
Otieno: Bring KDG in on Sunday. Me: Is it 85k final? Otieno: Parts might change. Me: Don't surprise me.
Mama: Joseph, the tank is dripping again. Me: I'll send 20k now and the rest in December. Mama: I did not ask for money. Me: I know.

calendar.event: NTSA inspection for KDF 902 and KDE 660

relations.about: Wife, nurse at a county health centre, practical, worries about fees.
Conductor, young father, sometimes careless with cash.
Mechanic, good but slow, accepts M-Pesa.

constraints: Cannot take buses off route more than a week
Needs plain-language answers; no legal jargon
sensitive: Savings only KES 40,000 against school fees of 112,000
Believes someone inside the SACCO may profit from fine inflation
Has paid a 'facilitation' once and still feels bad

disclosure_policy.t0_public: Manages six matatus on the Thika Road route; family man; plays football.
disclosure_policy.t1_after_signal: His record of fines, the general suspicion about the tickets, the rising costs.
disclosure_policy.t2_after_trust: School fee shortage, the SACCO tension.
